evidence: TDMA T was vaporized from the liquid at 50°C and introduced into the ALD chamber via argon (Ar) carrier gas at a flow rate of 200 sccm. For the PA-ALD of TiN and TiC–TiN thin films, hydrogen radicals are used as a reducing agent along with NH3, which is used as a reactant gas in the conventional ALD of TiN.
